name: Pesto
siboNotes: Traditional pesto contains garlic which is very high in fructans and should be avoided during SIBO treatment. Even small amounts can trigger symptoms.
preparationTips: Make homemade pesto using garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Use only the green tops of scallions for mild onion flavor
Substitute with basil oil for pure basil flavor without garlic
Store homemade low-FODMAP pesto in refrigerator for up to one week
nutritionalHighlights: High in healthy monounsaturated fats from olive oil
Rich in vitamin K from fresh basil
Good source of calcium from parmesan cheese
